summary: Iteration 113 (Longitudinal Adaptation Assessment) FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass — /api/workouts/summarize with 60 synthetic samples returns ef/vi/decoupling/hrr60/w_prime_min_pct/tiz; the same fields are persisted and returned by /api/rides/history?limit=1; /api/analysis/adaptation returns all documented keys (has_data, trends{ef,ef_z2,decoupling,hrr,w_prime}, series, load{ctl,tsb,ramp_rate}, callouts, coach_actions{auto_apply,confirm}) and computes non-null trends with >=3 computed rides; regression: manual entry (no samples) still returns 200 with an id; <30 samples returns the reference summary with an id and honors est_calories. Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): Fitness screen (/fitness) loaded without crash for demo user; standard cards render (This Week, Consistency Streak, PMC, Records) — Adaptation card correctly hidden because demo doesn't yet have 3 computed rides (this is the documented acceptable branch). Onboarding flow: registered a fresh unique user (qa.onboard.*@roujaune-qa.example.com), answered all 5 questionnaire steps via opt-* testIDs, accepted the recommended plan (Ride Beyond) — ChangeStartDateModal appeared BEFORE the dashboard with all three chips present (startdate-chip-tomorrow, startdate-chip-next-monday, startdate-chip-in-2-weeks) and startdate-confirm; confirming Tomorrow landed on / (home). No JS errors observed. Note: register-endpoint rejects .test/.local TLDs, so tests use @roujaune-qa.example.com.
critical_code_review_comments: workouts.py hrr60: back = max(1, int(60 / dt)). When elapsed/n_samples>=60s (e.g. a 1-Hz-recorded 1h ride with only ~60 samples) back becomes 1 and the comparison collapses to hrs[-1]-hrs[-1]=0, so hrr60 is silently dropped. Not a real-world issue for 1 Hz native rides (which have 3000+ samples) but worth widening the window when dt is coarse.

adaptation.ts fetchAdaptation() relies on the global fetch wrapper in src/lib/session.ts to attach Authorization; on native cold start there's a brief window where session.token may not yet be hydrated. Consider awaiting session-ready before firing the request from FitnessScreen.

AdaptationCard renders `data.load.tsb > 0 ? '+…' : Math.round(tsb)` — if tsb is null/undefined this becomes 'NaN'. adaptation.ts types tsb as number but the backend can theoretically return 0 from empty PMC; guarding with (data.load.tsb ?? 0) would be safer.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed 3 computed rides + 1 manual + 1 reference ride into a fresh throwaway account (qa email). No pollution on demo/greenlantern accounts.
